name: Ecoajedrez-AR
status: Immersive approved-inspired fantasy UI: panoramic celestial chess arena, animated floating figures, themed responsive settings and illustrated biome preview. Core chess, PvP and WebXR unaffected; human browser/mobile acceptance tests pending.
onlinePvP: Casual PeerJS beta, 6-character code and QR; unranked and not independently anti-cheat verified
modelType: Six bundled original glTF Staunton models + procedurally enhanced royal/fantasy/classic variants; no third-party franchise assets
arImplementation: WebXR hit-test with touch/aim + recovery dialog after interrupted Android session; screen-drag feedback, NOT camera hand recognition or hand occlusion
validationBasis: El usuario confirmó AR y funcionamiento invitado de v0.5; el nuevo 0.6 necesita pruebas físicas, entre dos celulares y desbloqueo.
googleAuth: Server-only BFF code exists but no Cloudflare Functions secrets deployed; Google unavailable on GitHub Pages; guest fully usable
localPersistence: LocalStorage por UID o invitado, sin servicio externo
diagnostics: WebXR, WebGL2, Firebase SDK, PeerJS, modelos, conexión, micrófono
securityReview: No external domains, keys, paid services, new login, third-party fonts, pixels or tracking; no changes to server and gameplay
ui: Arcane Glass 0.10: expanded desktop cinematic welcome with playing stage and local themed original celestial illustration + CSS float, high-contrast actual buttons, illustrated menu, settings preview and sidebar real controls, no clipped logo with scroll-safe screens

media.notes: Foreground/chrome never masked by ambient video. Only one MP4 decoded at a time and autoplay never blocks guest mode. Mapping of MP4 by original filenames is provisional pending visual confirmation. Intro requires click.

visualFidelity: Original vector recreation based on approved mockup, NOT pixel-identical generated artwork; approved screenshots contain non-interactive UI and are not used verbatim as background
